thread_message.description: One turn of a Member conversation.

conversation_reply_request.description: Sent backend→agent when a Member's reply arrives (possibly days later, possibly after an agent restart): the conversation resumes mid-thread from the agent's checkpoint. The reply is typed text ('message') or a voice note ('audio', transcribed by the agent's env-keyed STT client) — exactly one of the two. The thread, contact point, question list, and resumable link ride along: the backend owns the durable record, and re-sending them lets a cold agent rebuild context, deliver on the right channel (re-offering the link after partial answers), and pace the same question list.

message.description: The Member's typed reply. Exactly one of message / audio.

audio.description: The Member's voice note, base64-encoded; the agent transcribes it with its STT client (env-keyed, faked in tests) and the transcript becomes the reply text.

format.description: Audio container/format hint, e.g. 'ogg', 'mp4' — rides the transcription upload as the filename extension.

thread.description: The thread so far, oldest first — the durable record the backend owns and re-sends, so the agent can rebuild its context even from a cold checkpoint.

contact.description: The Member's channel-qualified contact point, e.g. 'whatsapp:+353860000001'.

questions.description: The conversation's full question list, in order.

resume_url.description: The Member's resumable link, re-offered after partial answers ('Members receive resumable links after partial answers'). Empty string when the deployment has no public URL.

conversation_response.description: The agent's answer for a conversation turn (start or reply): delivery acknowledgement, the conversation status, the full thread, and the answers gathered so far.

delivered.description: Whether the agent's latest Channel message was acknowledged by the medium. A reply is only ever reported as sent once the medium has it.

status.description: awaiting_member: paused on a checkpoint, waiting for the Member. completed: all questions answered (or the Member said done). stopped: the Member declined to continue.
